anchorage.summary: Alaskan Command at Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson coordinates homeland defense, civil support and mission assurance within Alaska.

acquisition.summary: ALCOM is a mission command; named host contracting support does not establish an independent ALCOM office or permit attributing all JBER spend to this node.
